assistant.label: AI Assistant
assistant.welcome:
**Welcome to Global Nature Watch Horizon!**

Hi, I'm your nature monitoring assistant, powered by AI and open data from [Global Nature Watch](https://globalnaturewatch.org) and [Land & Carbon Lab](https://landcarbonlab.org).

You can ask me about land cover change, forest loss, or biodiversity risks in places you care about. For more details on how to get started, check out the [Help Center](https://help.horizon.globalnaturewatch.org/get-started).
assistant.placeholder: Or describe what you want to explore…
assistant.prompt.grassland: Show changes in grassland extent in Mongolia.
assistant.prompt.forest: What were the top three causes of tree loss in Brazil?
assistant.prompt.landcover: Show the biggest changes in land cover in Kenya between 2015 and 2024.
assistant.promptCount: {count, plural, =0 {No suggested prompts} one {# suggested prompt} other {# suggested prompts}}
